rules.text: Sika® SealTape S is not suitable for swimming pools
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: Apply the mixed Sikalastic 1K waterproof mortar/membrane on both sides of the joint/ edge, leaving ~10 mm on both sides of the edge free from mortar. 1. Place the Sika® SealTape-S on the coated joint/ edge and press the tape firmly into the mortar. 2. Cover the edges of the tape to leaave the middle 10mm exposed and free from all mortar/membrane. 3. Continue tiling application with the appropriate tile adhesive and grout. 4. For sealing corners, around taps and pipe penetrations
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

rules.text: Ancillary Waterproofing products: Sika sikalastic 1K For other similar Sika® products that may also be suitable for use with Sika® SealTape S, contact local Sika Technical Services Department.
